notes: A zen turn no longer shows the same line twice, once dimmed as a thought and once in white as the paragraph. Some harnesses mirror a reasoning summary as the very next assistant message word for word; groupTurnItems (transcriptActivity.ts, repeatsNextProse) now drops a reasoning block whose whitespace-normalised text equals the next non-empty assistant block, so only the white paragraph renders. A thought the agent did not repeat still sits as a step in its group. Test: transcriptActivity.test.ts (a repeated thought drops, an unrepeated one stays).
